parameters.query:
SET app.as_of = $1;

WITH hw_ordered AS (
  SELECT student_id, deadline, submitted_at,
    CASE WHEN submitted_at::date <= deadline THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS on_time,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY student_id ORDER BY deadline) AS rn,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY student_id) AS total
  FROM homework WHERE submitted_at IS NOT NULL
    AND submitted_at::date <= $1::date AND deadline <= $1::date
),
hist AS (
  SELECT student_id, AVG(on_time::float) AS hist_rate
  FROM hw_ordered WHERE rn <= FLOOR(total * 0.6)
  GROUP BY student_id
),
recent AS (
  SELECT student_id, AVG(on_time::float) AS recent_rate
  FROM hw_ordered WHERE rn > total - 3
  GROUP BY student_id
)
SELECT h.student_id,
  CASE WHEN hi.hist_rate > 0.8 AND r.recent_rate < 0.5
       THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
  END AS submission_timing_shift
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT student_id FROM homework) h
LEFT JOIN hist   hi ON hi.student_id = h.student_id
LEFT JOIN recent r  ON r.student_id  = h.student_id;

SELECT
  s.student_id, s.name, s.slack_id, s.course, s.mentor_id, s.status,
  MAX(l.login_date)                                              AS last_login_date,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN l.login_date >= $1::date - 7   THEN 1 END)   AS last7_logins,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN l.login_date >= $1::date - 28
             AND  l.login_date <  $1::date - 7   THEN 1 END)   AS prev4wk_logins,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN h.status = 'missed'            THEN 1 END)   AS missed_hw,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN h.submitted_at IS NOT NULL
             AND  h.submitted_at::date > h.deadline THEN 1 END) AS late_hw,
  COUNT(h.id)                                                   AS total_hw,
  $1::date - MAX(m.message_date)                                AS last_msg_days_ago,
  BOOL_OR(m.to_mentor)                                          AS wrote_to_mentor
FROM students_n8n s
LEFT JOIN login_events_n8n   l ON l.student_id = s.student_id AND l.login_date <= $1::date
LEFT JOIN homework           h ON h.student_id = s.student_id AND h.deadline <= $1::date
LEFT JOIN slack_messages_n8n m ON m.student_id = s.student_id
                              AND m.is_from_student = TRUE
                              AND m.message_date <= $1::date
GROUP BY s.student_id, s.name, s.slack_id, s.course, s.mentor_id, s.status
ORDER BY s.student_id;

SET app.as_of = $1;

SELECT student_id,
  ARRAY_AGG(text ORDER BY message_date DESC) AS recent_messages
FROM slack_messages_n8n
WHERE is_from_student = TRUE
  AND message_date <= $1::date
GROUP BY student_id;
